entries.name: Push in
entries.what_it_does: Scales the panel up slowly, as if the camera creeps forward.
entries.when_to_use: A line that should feel more serious as it goes on; the last panel before a turn.
entries.when_not_to_use: Panels under 1.5 s; when text sits near the frame edge.

entries.name: Pull out
entries.what_it_does: Starts slightly enlarged and settles back to full frame.

entries.name: Punch in
entries.what_it_does: Fast zoom toward a point that then holds.
entries.when_to_use: The single word or number the voice stresses.
entries.when_not_to_use: More than once per scene; calm moods.

entries.name: Snap zoom
entries.what_it_does: Zooms in and straight back out.
entries.when_to_use: A beat hit or a comic double-take.

entries.name: Crash zoom
entries.what_it_does: Panel arrives from a 40% over-scale with blur and lands sharp.
entries.when_not_to_use: Text-heavy panels; any style that bans blur.

entries.name: Pan left
entries.what_it_does: Slides the over-scaled panel a few percent to the left.
entries.when_to_use: A sense of travel or reading direction.

entries.name: Pan right
entries.what_it_does: Slides the over-scaled panel a few percent to the right.
entries.when_to_use: Following a figure that faces right.

entries.name: Tilt up
entries.what_it_does: Moves the frame upward over the panel.

entries.name: Tilt down
entries.what_it_does: Moves the frame downward over the panel.
entries.when_to_use: Decline, weight, landing on a caption.

entries.name: Slow drift
entries.when_to_use: Long calm panels that would otherwise be dead still.
entries.when_not_to_use: Styles that hold dead still while text is read.

entries.name: Camera shake
entries.what_it_does: Random frame jitter that decays to nothing.
entries.when_to_use: An impact, a crash, a shock figure.
entries.when_not_to_use: Longer than half a second; more than twice a film.

entries.name: Handheld drift
entries.what_it_does: Soft, slow wander and roll like a hand-held camera.

entries.name: Dutch tilt
entries.what_it_does: Eases the frame into a few degrees of roll.
entries.when_not_to_use: Charts and lists; more than one panel in a row.

entries.name: Orbit sway
entries.what_it_does: One slow roll left and right across the panel.

entries.name: Rack focus
entries.what_it_does: Panel starts blurred and pulls sharp.
entries.when_to_use: Opening a scene; revealing an object.

entries.name: Defocus out
entries.what_it_does: Panel blurs away at its end.
entries.when_not_to_use: Before a hard cut on the beat.
